profile.group: Murugappa group. Promoter group 44.11% at Jun-2026, of which Ambadi Investments ~36% (q1deck p.10).
profile.standalone: Engineering (cold-drawn welded and ERW precision tubes, cold-rolled steel strips, tubular components; India's largest precision-tube maker); Metal Formed Products (automotive drive and cam chains, fine-blanked parts, roll-formed car door frames, railway coach parts); Mobility (BSA, Hercules, Montra, Mach City cycles, fitness equipment, Track & Trail retail); Others (industrial chains under Rombo/Diamond brands, TMT bars, truck body works, optic lens, TI Machine Building, 3xper CDMO, Orange Koi). 35+ plants, 29,500+ employees, exports ~14% of standalone revenue (q1call).
profile.subsidiaries: CG Power and Industrial Solutions (listed; motors, transformers, switchgear, railway equipment, semiconductors via CG Semi OSAT and Axiro), Shanthi Gears (listed; gears and gearboxes), TI Clean Mobility (Montra Electric: e-3W, e-tractors; IPLTech 95.58%: e-trucks; TIVOLT 100%: e-SCV; Jayem 50%), TI Medical (67%; sutures, surgical consumables), 3xper Innoventure (95%; CDMO/APIs), Kcaltech (67%; aluminium HVAC tubes), Financière C10/Sedis (France; industrial chains), Orange Koi (76.24% from Apr-2026; metal injection moulding)

ticmpl.investors: Multiples Private Equity Fund III/IV and co-investors (equity + Series A1 CCPS, about Rs1,200 cr, FY24) and South Asia Growth Invest III / South Asia EBT Trust III (Temasek group; about Rs580 cr, agreement 6-May-2024). Conversion only at an IPO; stake on conversion depends on the IPO valuation.
ticmpl.accounting: Until Mar-2026 investors' CCPS were a liability at fair value (consolidated FV loss Rs136.70 cr FY25, Rs18.00 cr FY26) and TII's Series B CCPS an FVTPL asset (standalone FV gain Rs569 cr FY25, Rs6.80 cr FY26). The restated SHA of 30-Mar-2026 fixed the number of conversion shares: investors' CCPS (Rs2,404.70 cr) moved to non-controlling interest; TII's CCPS now at cost.

ticmpl.breakeven: One of the four EV businesses expected to break even in FY27, two more in FY28 (MD TICMPL, q1call); 'directionally' past peak quarterly losses.

guidance.t: Steel cost inflation in Q4FY26-Q1FY27 compressed margins; contracts pass it on with a 2-3 quarter lag and TII expects to recover it fully, including Q1's under-recovery; non-steel (fuel, freight) inflation under negotiation.
Capex FY27: TII ~Rs350 cr, Shanthi Gears ~Rs100 cr, group excluding CG Power Rs600-700 cr. FY26 guidance was Rs300-350 cr for TII and ~Rs300 cr into subsidiaries.
TICMPL: Rs250 cr infused in Q4FY26, another Rs250 cr planned in Q3FY27; Rs750 cr in total over time.
Cycles: at least another ~2 points of margin in FY27 (target ~5% PBIT).

TI Medical ~20% revenue growth a year; IV cannula plant (Medicura assets bought for ~Rs34 cr, Mar-2026) to start Aug-Sep 2026. 3xper: 200 KL intermediate capacity commissioned, regulatory inspection expected in FY28.

MFP: western-region greenfield running ~6 months late; railways unprofitable in tenders; Hyundai-dependent unit weak. CRSS plant at Nashik to be fully used by end-FY27/mid-FY28; western tube capacity at ~30% utilisation (May-2026).

cgPower.q1fy27: Revenue Rs3,281 cr (+14%), PBT Rs423 cr (+16%), PAT Rs308 cr; EHV switchgear plant (Nashik) commissioned 4-Jun-2026; CG Semi's G1 OSAT plant at Sanand began commercial production 4-Jul-2026 (JV with Renesas and Stars Microelectronics).
